home.seoP1: Travellab is a full-service travel agency based in Baku, offering customers flights, hotel booking, ready-made tour packages, visa services, and event tickets all in one place. We're a member of the Azerbaijan Travel Agencies Association (ATAA) and have served individual, corporate, and VIP clients reliably for years.
home.seoP2: As a travel agency, our main goal is to give customers a fast, reliable, and convenient way to book flights and hotels without wasting time. When searching for flights, we compare offers from hundreds of airlines to bring you the best price and flight time. Through our hotel booking service, you can choose accommodation anywhere in the world that fits your budget.
home.seoP3: Our ready-made tour packages cover Dubai, Turkey, Georgia, and other popular destinations — including flights, hotel, and transfer at affordable prices. Our visa service makes the paperwork for your trip easier. We also support international customers in medical tourism.
home.seoP4: Through our Labpoint loyalty program, you earn bonus points with every booking and can use them on your next trip. As a travel agency, Travellab puts customer satisfaction first, working to make every trip of yours comfortable and unforgettable.

items.q: What's included in the tour price?
items.a: In most cases, the tour price includes a flight ticket, hotel stay, and sometimes local transfer — full details for each tour are shown in the listing description. Costs not included in the price (e.g. meals, excursions) are noted separately.

items.q: How do I book a tour?
items.a: Click the "Call" button to reach our manager — they'll explain availability, payment terms, and required documents.

items.q: Can I use my Lab Points toward a tour purchase?
items.a: Yes. Your account's Lab Point balance is automatically applied as a discount on the tour price, and you pay the remainder. You also earn new Lab Points with every tour purchase.

items.q: If I cancel a tour, will I get a refund?
items.a: Cancellation and refund terms vary by each tour's hotel and flight supplier — before booking, our manager will tell you the specific terms for that tour.

items.q: How do "Group Tours" differ from regular tours?
items.a: Group tours run on pre-set dates together with other travelers and are usually offered at a better price. With individual tours, you can choose your own dates and route.

items.q: Is a visa included in the tour price?
items.a: Usually not — a visa is a separate service. If needed, you can apply at the same time through our Visa section.

items.q: If a tour's date has passed (shown as "Ended"), can I still reach out?
items.a: The "Ended" status only means that specific date has passed — you can contact us to find out if new dates are available for a similar route.

items.q: Is installment payment available for tours?
items.a: Some tours offer installment payment via bank card — you can confirm availability when discussing your chosen tour with a manager.

viza.countryPageFaqTitle: What to Know About a {{country}} Visa

items.q: How soon will you contact me after I submit a request?
items.a: Usually within a few hours, and even faster during business hours — our manager will reach out via WhatsApp or phone.

items.q: What documents are required for a visa?
items.a: Required documents vary by country — a passport, photo, bank statement, employment reference, and hotel/flight booking are the most common. Once you select a country and submit the form, our specialist will send you the full list.

items.q: How long does getting a visa take?
items.a: The timeline depends on the country and the consulate's workload — usually a few business days to a few weeks. Our specialist will let you know the exact timeline after your application.

items.q: I was refused a visa before, can I still apply?
items.a: Yes. Mention this in the "Additional note" field of the form — our specialist will take the reason for the previous refusal into account and help prepare your documents more carefully.

items.q: I'm traveling with a child, are extra documents needed?
items.a: Yes, depending on age, the child's own passport, birth certificate, and in some cases parental consent may be required. Mention in the note that you're traveling with a child when submitting the form.

items.q: When do I pay for your service?
items.a: Submitting a request and the initial consultation are free. Payment is only required once the service terms have been agreed with you.

items.q: Is one visa enough for all Schengen countries, or do I need to apply separately for each?
items.a: Once you have a Schengen visa, you can travel to all countries in the Schengen area — no separate visa is required. We apply to the consulate of the country matching your main travel plan.

items.q: Is it possible to get a visa faster in an emergency?
items.a: An expedited application option is available for some countries, for an extra official fee. Note the date in the form, and our specialist will let you know if this option is possible.

vizaFaq.countryQ1: How many days does a {{country}} visa take?
vizaFaq.countryA1: The timeline depends on the country's consulate, the season, and the application type. Our specialist will tell you the exact timeline for {{country}} after you submit the form.
vizaFaq.countryQ2: What documents are needed for a {{country}} visa?
vizaFaq.countryA2: Required documents vary depending on the purpose of travel (tourism, work, visiting relatives, etc.). Once you select a country and submit the form, our specialist will send you the full document list for {{country}}.
vizaFaq.countryQ3: How does Travellab help with a {{country}} visa?
vizaFaq.countryA3: As a travel agency, Travellab provides full support for a {{country}} visa, from document preparation to application — we prepare the list of required documents, help fill out forms, and simplify communication with the consulate.
